title: 第两千六百五十三章那便证明给我看第两千六百五十二章最关键的蜕变
slug: 开局成为首座签到极道帝兵
lines: 在场生灵无不向纳兰家投去羡慕的目光，尤其是那些活了悠久岁月的老辈强者们。
只有他们知道自己背后的势力为了培养少年天级别的强者付出了多少，现在看着纳兰家拥有了自己的少年天，如何能不羡慕？
这是崛起的最大希望！
哪怕现在是不可成天时代，成长到天下顶尖层次的少年天又该有多可怕？古今已经有许多战绩可以证明，天级不出无敌！
有一位天下巅峰层次的少年天坐镇，那将是完全不同的概念，谁人敢惹？哪怕是那些天级势力都得给面子！
这样一位强者不仅是族群的希望，更是整座天地的未来，会被所有人寄予厚望。
如果成天时代到来，这些人中每有一位踏入天级层次，整座天地的实力都会因此暴涨！
所有势力都想培养出一位少年天级别的强者，为此在幕后不断努力，可至今过去无数纪元时代，也没有几个势力成功。
别说少年天，准少年天都没有几个！
天命道院中，看着面前光幕中的景象，杨青禾为纳兰凌霄而高兴，他做到了，今后他终于真正有资格站在道无双身边了。
纳兰凌霄白发飘摇，通体璀璨，周身无垠剑光激荡古今纪元，无尽的剑气在未来、过去、现在飞舞，剑光夺目。
他的背后，一座更加璀璨的大世界出现，内部没有生灵，插满了各式战剑。
相比蜕变之前的虚幻世界，眼前这座世界已经彻底凝实，那些战剑也全部都是真的，拥有着可怕威能。
“独属于他一人的剑道世界。”古惊鸿开口，纳兰凌霄蜕变后，这座世界也跟着蜕变，此刻已经拥有极其可怕的威能。
这是纳兰凌霄道的本身，如果他的道是通天剑道，那眼前这座世界就是通天界。
“不错不错。”战祖点点头，觉得纳兰凌霄背后的剑道世界有些说法。
“现在的你应该能够取悦我了，我也不用再留手藏拙了。”
开天大笑，依旧是第六把开天九剑，但此刻自他身上爆发出的霸道剑气却比之前还要更强了数倍。
“我要多谢你，但这场胜利无论如何也不能让给你。”纳兰凌霄开口，蜕变后的他变得更加空灵，双眸都在喷吐剑道真意。
“那便证明给我看。”
开天攻来，剑气霸道，只凭蛮力都能横推这一境九成九的强者。
宇宙一座接一座的炸开，如同一个个气泡般，根本承受不住开天那霸道的剑气。
“通天剑诀！”
纳兰凌霄无需再避让，自正面杀向开天，两人造成的波动瞬间湮灭了数千大宇宙，世界成群的毁灭，虚无更是举目破败。
狂暴的剑气疯狂交错，挤满了无尽宇宙，纳兰凌霄和开天激烈大战，蜕变后的他肉眼可见的强大了，已经不虚开天。
“有趣有趣。”
开天大笑着祭出开天剑诀，狂暴的剑诀带着毁灭天地的霸道意志落下。
纳兰凌霄被霸道的力量撞上了九天，肉身遭到了极大的冲击。
但他如今已是少年天，强大了不止一个层次，只是这样的攻击还无法真正伤到他。
不过开天的开天剑诀竟是越来越强，一击胜过一击，到了最后，剑光已经如太初大日般夺目，刺得纳兰凌霄都难以直视。
“轰隆！”
纳兰凌霄以通天剑诀迎击，同时，背后的剑道世界也在融入他的身体与长剑中，他的实力因此暴涨，挡住了开天的攻击。
两人的狂暴大战震惊了所有人。
这一战太纯粹了，只有最直接的硬碰硬！
content_en:
All the creatures present looked at the Nalan family with envy, especially the powerful elders who had lived for a long time.
Only they know how much the forces behind them have paid to cultivate a strong man at the level of Young Heaven. Now that the Nalan family has their own Young Heaven, how can they not be envious?
This is the greatest hope for rise!
Even if this is an era of impossibility, how terrifying would it be for a young boy who has grown to the top level in the world? There are many achievements in ancient and modern times that can prove that you are invincible at the heaven level!
It would be a completely different concept if there was a young man who was at the top of the world, Tian Tian, ​​sitting in charge. Who would dare to mess with him? Even those heaven-level forces have to give face!
Such a strong man is not only the hope of the ethnic group, but also the future of the entire world, and will have high hopes for everyone.
If the Chengtian Era comes, and every one of these people steps into the heaven level, the strength of the entire world will skyrocket!
All the forces want to cultivate a strong man at the level of the Young Heavenly One, and they have been working hard behind the scenes, but so far in countless epochs, few forces have succeeded.
Not to mention young people, there are not many who are close to being young!
In Tianming Taoist Temple, looking at the scene in the light curtain in front of him, Yang Qinghe was happy for Nalan Lingxiao. He had done it. From now on, he was finally qualified to stand beside Dao Wushuang.
Nalan Lingxiao's white hair is swaying, and his whole body is dazzling. The boundless sword light around him stirs up ancient and modern eras. The endless sword energy is flying in the future, past and present, and the sword light is dazzling.
Behind him, a more dazzling world appeared. There were no living creatures inside, and it was filled with all kinds of swords.
Compared with the illusory world before the transformation, the world in front of him has completely solidified, and all the swords are real, possessing terrifying power.
"The world of swordsmanship belongs to him alone." Gu Jinghong said, after Nalan Lingxiao transformed, this world also transformed, and now it has extremely terrifying power.
This is Nalan Lingxiao's Tao itself. If his Tao is Tongtian Sword Tao, then the world in front of him is Tongtian Realm.
"Not bad, not bad." Zhan Zu nodded, feeling that there was something to be said about the world of swordsmanship behind Nalan Lingxiao.
"You should be able to please me now, and I don't have to hold back any more."
Kaitian laughed, it was still the sixth Kaitian Nine Swords, but the domineering sword energy erupting from him at this moment was several times stronger than before.
"I want to thank you, but I can't give this victory to you no matter what." Nalan Lingxiao said. After the transformation, he became more ethereal, and his eyes were spitting out the true meaning of swordsmanship.
"Then prove it to me."
When Kai Tian attacks, his sword energy is domineering, and he can overwhelm ninety-nine percent of the strongest men in this realm with just his brute strength.
The universe exploded one after another, like bubbles, unable to withstand Kaitian's overbearing sword energy.
"Tiantian Sword Technique!"
Nalan Lingxiao no longer needed to evade, and attacked Kaitian from the front. The fluctuations caused by the two of them instantly annihilated thousands of universes. Groups of worlds were destroyed, and nothingness was shattered as far as the eye could see.
The violent sword energy criss-crossed crazily, filling the endless universe. Nalan Lingxiao and Kaitian fought fiercely. After transformation, he was visibly powerful, and he was no longer as powerful as Kaitian.
“Interesting and interesting.”
Kaitian laughed and used the Kaitian Sword Art. The violent sword art fell with the domineering will to destroy the world.
Nalan Lingxiao was hit by the overbearing force and hit Jiutian, and his physical body suffered a huge impact.
But now that he is a teenager, he is more powerful than one level, but such attacks cannot really hurt him.
However, Kaitian's Kaitian Sword Technique actually became stronger and stronger, each blow was stronger than the last. In the end, the sword light was as dazzling as the great sun in the beginning, and it was so piercing that even Nalan Lingxiao could not look directly.
"Boom!"
Nalan Lingxiao used the Tongtian Sword Technique to meet the attack. At the same time, the world of swordsmanship behind him was also integrated into his body and long sword. As a result, his strength surged and he blocked Kaitian's attack.
The violent fight between the two shocked everyone.
This battle is too pure, only the most direct head-on confrontation!
